notes.notes:
Watch there : [url=https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561199098056453][u]CLICK[/u][/url]

In view of the approaching Steam Neo Fest, [b]Saturday, October 8[/b] will take place the broadcast of my [b]gampelay live from my game, White: The Hero's return[/b], a mix between a rather complicated [i]RPG[/i], [i]die and retry[/i] and [i]bullet hell[/i]! I would answer, at the same time, questions orally or in writing in french. I would also be accompanied by Saki, the "co-founder" of the game and a friend.

For more information on the game, [url=https://kdt1.webnode.fr/][i][u]it's this way[/u][/i][/url]

PS: We will probably be late.
